'''Michael Dalton''' (also published as '''Mike Dalton''' and '''Michael L. Dalton''')<ref name="dt-3607">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3607 High Destiny Docking Bay Hunt Down], DeckTech (Michael "faramir" Dalton, 22 February 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/3607/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/3607/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018202124/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/3607/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''faramir''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in February 2000. He posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in 1998<ref name="list-36964">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/36964.html? swccg-discussion message #36964], Michael L. Dalton (1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000110130903/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/36964.html? Internet Archive]</ref> and published constructed lists on Decipher Deck Designs, among them [[Mike Dalton EPP Mains/Beatdown (Intermediate)]] (LS, July 1999).
